text:
maya: quick sync 1: want to lock the benchmark narrative for launch + webinar. angle: "tail-first" — show p95/p99 impact + net $/response after optimizations.

jo: makes sense. user slices? i suggest support chat, meeting-transcript, and code-assist. covers short, long, bursty.

rafael: i'll pull cleaned numbers (same model + config). will include avg/p95/p99 and $/1k raw vs optimized.

camila: design asks: hero = two-panel PNG (left: tail latency CDFs, right: grouped bars raw vs optimized $/1k). mobile-friendly legend, alt text, >1200px width.

tanya: webinar copy option: "Predictable tails. Lower bills." short subhead: "Same model. Smarter serving." CTA: run a 2-minute perf check / join webinar.

oliver: we should add a micro waterfall under cost bars listing savings sources: batching, cache hits, small-quant. one sentence each.

anna-brand: social blurb: "Keep 95th latency tight while cutting run costs. See the numbers & demo." under 120 chars.

ci-bot: perf-run/4912300 complete. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/perf/4912300 :white_check_mark:

maya: timeline: rafael numbers by EOD Tue, camila mocks Wed AM, jo blog skeleton Wed PM, tanya webinar flow Thu, anna final copy Thu PM.

rafael: sample CSV snippet I'm sharing in the doc: 

```
segment,avg_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k_raw,cost_per_1k_opt
support-chat,110,280,500,$11.5,$7.0
meeting-transcript,450,960,1500,$30.2,$18.0
code-assist,95,230,420,$14.2,$9.1
```

jo: good. i'll draft a 3-line appendix explaining tail metrics + how we measured batching/cache. include reproducibility steps and link to artifact.

camila: export hero PNG with accessible alt text and quick legend copy for social thumbnails.

maya: experiment idea: poll in webinar reg: "Which matters most? Lower cost / Lower tail latency / Predictable throughput" to route leads.

tanya: i'll wire poll and tag leads by answer.

maya: keep claims defensible — label workloads and config in appendix. sync Fri 10am for preflight. :rocket:
